display.purpose: Hero head (uppercase on Latin pages) and footer mast. Phones: 15.5vw (13.5vw JA, line-height 1.02).

heading.purpose: Section heads, the services list at poster scale, the open accordion pass, contact detail rows.

lead.purpose: Ledes at 26 to 34ch; in the display face at 800 for card titles, closed accordion tabs, the team heading and the footer start tile.

body.purpose: Running text, 36 to 48ch, tabular numerals; buttons, stamps and person names in the display face at 800. JA line-height 1.85.

small.purpose: Form labels (600), roles, hints, footer meta and credits.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The single easing curve for every transition and animation.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: Button and input background, colour and press transitions.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Pressed controls drop 1px down and right, a sheet landing.

motion.name: print-run
motion.purpose: Desktop hero pin: the seam rises as the sheet feeds into the drum; the spark registers, squares up and turns a quarter turn.

motion.name: masked-line
motion.purpose: Each hero headline line rises from behind its mask on load; the lede fades up at 520ms.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Section entrances for data-rise parts, armed only by the .motion class from rise.ts.

motion.name: press-loop
motion.purpose: The press-room video plays only on screen and never under reduced motion.

motion.name: accordion
motion.purpose: The open process pass widens to 4.2; bodies fade 300 to 400ms.

motion.name: nav-away
motion.purpose: The nav hides on scroll down past 120px and returns on scroll up or focus.

motion.name: plate-strike
motion.purpose: Poster plates strike off register on each keystroke and settle.

motion.name: mast-register
motion.purpose: The footer mast pink plate travels from 0.2em / 0.16em into register with scroll.

motion.name: stamp
motion.purpose: A form result lands like a rubber stamp; opacity-only 180ms under reduced motion.

motion.name: view-transition
motion.purpose: Cross-document language switch; the nav holds still (view-transition-name: site-nav).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All movement sits inside a no-preference query; pins release, the press video pauses, the spark stays a static two-ink print.

rules.separation: tone step or space; no borders, hairlines or outlines on surfaces or controls
rules.focus: 2px solid focus, offset 3px on stock; 3px pink offset 2px on blue-field inputs; 2px pink offset -4px on accordion tabs
rules.grain: background-image specks on ink fields only
rules.drawOnce: decorative duplicate text from data-text via ::before content: attr(data-text)
rules.duotone: grayscale(1) contrast(1.15) multiplied on paper-3, ink layer above under lighten
rules.sparkPlates: pink halftone at 15deg (7px cell), blue at 75deg (6px cell), multiply
rules.flexRails: min-width: 0 on flex rails and tracks

narrative.overview:
Every surface is a print run on bright, cool, uncoated stock through two drums. A medium blue drum sets every word and stroke; a fluorescent pink drum lays every fill. Purple is never mixed: it appears only where the two inks overprint, through `mix-blend-mode: multiply`. There is no black anywhere, and no third ink.

The page is told in colour chapters. Each section is a full-bleed field of one ink or screen, and the next section is a different field: stock meeting the blue drum at a waterline in the hero, the deep pink screen for services, the deepest blue for the press room, stock with a dark-to-light blue accordion for process, full pink for about, full blue for contact, and a board of filled tiles to close. Nothing is outlined. Surfaces are told apart by a tone step and by space, never by a rule or a frame.

The page is flat paper. Depth comes from overprint and registration, not from light: the hero seam rising as the sheet feeds into the drum, the spark's plates pulling into register, the poster plates striking off register and settling, the footer mast's pink plate travelling home. Paper specks (grain) appear only where ink has been laid. Type is heavy and close-set: Cabinet Grotesk 800 over Literata, with Dela Gothic One and Zen Kaku Gothic New on Japanese pages.
keyCharacteristics: Light cool stock, blue ink, pink fill, purple only from multiply overprint, no black.
Colour chapters: one full-bleed field per section, separated by tone and space.
No hairlines, no outlined boxes, no shadows; secondary controls are filled tones.
Grain as background-image specks on ink fields only.
Five type steps; heavy display (800) over a serif reading face.
Found pictures in one two-drum duotone, credited in the footer.
Motion is registration: plates drift and land, sheets feed, parts rise in turn.

rules.name: The Two Drums Rule
rules.body: Blue draws (words, strokes, icons); pink fills (buttons, stamps, selection, underlines, plates). A colour doing the other drum's job is a defect.

rules.name: The Overprint Purple Rule
rules.body: Purple is never a token. It exists only where a pink and a blue layer cross under `mix-blend-mode: multiply`.

rules.name: The No Black Rule
rules.body: No `#000`, no neutral greys. The darkest value on the page is pink-ink.

rules.name: The Grain-on-Ink Rule
rules.body: The grain specks are a `background-image` beside a `background-color` on ink fields (the services, about and contact chapters, the hero drum, pink buttons, the poster, picture plates). Bare stock carries no grain.

rules.name: The Ordered Screens Rule
rules.body: When fields carry an order, they step through one drum's screens darkest to lightest (ink, ink-3, ink-4, ink-5). Text flips from on-ink to pink-ink at ink-4.

rules.name: The Five Steps Rule
rules.body: Type sizes come only from the five step tokens (display, heading, lead, body, small). A new size is a new step or it is a defect.

rules.name: The One Weight Rule
rules.body: Heads are 800 and only 800. Dela Gothic One has a single weight, so Japanese pages set `font-synthesis-weight: none` and Latin inside Japanese heads stays in Cabinet 800.

rules.name: The Phrase Break Rule
rules.body: Japanese heads and ledes (`.phrased`) use `word-break: keep-all` and break only at the U+200B phrase marks placed in the copy. Running Japanese text uses `word-break: auto-phrase` with `line-break: strict`.

rules.name: The Tone-and-Space Rule
rules.body: Two surfaces that touch differ by a tone step, or they are held apart by space. If a boundary needs a line to be seen, the tones are too close.

rules.name: The Shrinkable Rail Rule
rules.body: Any flex child that carries a track, a rail or long text sets `min-width: 0`, so it can shrink inside its parent instead of pushing the page wide.

rules.name: The Overprint Depth Rule
rules.body: Stack with multiply and offset, never with shadows or glows. If a layer needs to read "above", it overprints.

rules.name: The One Hair Off Rule
rules.body: Misregistration is a signature and stays rare: the spark's plates, the poster's plates, the footer mast. Body text and controls are always in register.

rules.name: The Draw-Once Rule
rules.body: Decorative duplicate text (the hero's stock copy of the headline, the poster plates, the mast's pink plate) is drawn from a `data-text` attribute through `::before { content: attr(data-text) }`, so the page carries each text once and assistive tech reads it once.

dos: **Do** draw every word and stroke in the blue drum and lay every fill in the pink drum or a screen of either.
**Do** make purple only by overprinting pink and blue layers with `mix-blend-mode: multiply`.
**Do** give each section one full-bleed field and separate chapters by a change of field and the section gap.
**Do** tell touching surfaces apart by a tone step; make a quieter control a filled screen (paper-2), not an outline.
**Do** put grain on ink fields as `background-image: var(--grain)` beside a `background-color`, never the `background` shorthand.
**Do** take every type size from the five step tokens and set heads in Cabinet Grotesk 800 (Dela Gothic One on JA) with `font-synthesis-weight: none` on Japanese pages.
**Do** mark Japanese head and lede phrase breaks with U+200B and keep them under `word-break: keep-all`.
**Do** draw decorative duplicate text from `data-text` pseudo-elements so the page carries each text once.
**Do** set `min-width: 0` on flex rails and tracks.
**Do** print found pictures in the two-drum duotone and credit them in the footer.
**Do** keep spatial motion inside a `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` query, and ship a static two-ink print for any WebGL piece.
**Do** print form and system states as stamped lines.
donts: **Don't** draw hairline rules, dividers, or outlined boxes, on surfaces or on controls.
**Don't** use black, neutral grey, or a cream or warm-white stock.
**Don't** add box-shadows or glows; depth is overprint.
**Don't** introduce a third ink or a purple token.
**Don't** duplicate text in the DOM for a decorative plate.
**Don't** show found pictures in their own colour.
**Don't** set display type at weights other than 800 or let the browser synthesise bold.
**Don't** add Tailwind utility classes; Tailwind supplies only preflight and the theme tokens, and components style themselves in scoped styles.
